title: Infrastruktura, data centar i rizici platforme
summary: Komponente cloud infrastrukture (fizičko okruženje, virtualizacija, mreža, storage, compute, management plane), dizajn sigurnog data centra (lokacija, HVAC, otpornost, Uptime Tier) i analiza i tretman rizika cloud platforme.
title_en: Infrastructure, data center, and platform risks
summary_en: Cloud infrastructure components (physical environment, virtualization, network, storage, compute, management plane), secure data center design (location, HVAC, resilience, Uptime Tier), and cloud platform risk analysis and treatment.
